turns.instruction: Build the cantilever from the attachment and report free-end Ux/Uz and fixed-end reaction My. The downward tip-force entry is 10 with no unit. Request only the missing force unit before solving. Use the attached input tables and OpenSees; include signed values, location, direction, units, case and current turn.
The downward tip force is 10 kN. Keep the independent +5 kN axial force, the left fixed end and the 3 m length. Analyze and report Ux and Uz at x=3 m and reaction My at x=0.
